svg.text: Redrawn from Fender 'Deluxe' Model 6G3 drawing (I-FA), page 1 of 2 (layout; page 2 is the schematic redrawn in this amp's schematic.kicad_sch) — not a trace
Note: the 6.3 V heater twisted pair always routes on the top layer and never joins another run — its crossings are not hop-overs.
